status_note: The ABP is before the action and this universe is after it. Quantity lives here, which is the first gap the foundation document names: counts within an interval, sums within an interval, the licence to operate simulation's per turn cost, and behaviour drift. The two are joined by exactly the edges that make drift and excess different measurements. Since v0.8.0 the cost walkthrough at /cost/ is written over this universe: every one of its clauses is a prohibition over a count, and the page says on its face that only a log held here, never on this site, can say whether one was kept.
